Property-first planning

What to check before renovating in Sammamish

Existing rooms and systems

When updating several rooms in a Sammamish home, compare their storage and daily routines on one plan. A larger kitchen is not an improvement if the circulation to the pantry, laundry, or outdoor living area becomes awkward.

Parcel and jurisdiction

Check Sammamish's property and permit resources before planning around trees, grade changes, or potential critical areas. Establish the buildable portion of the actual parcel rather than placing a standard backyard design first.

Access and staging

For a long or sloped driveway, identify a safe unloading location and test the path for large cabinets, appliances, and sheet materials. Include driveway protection and temporary household parking in the Sammamish construction plan.

Exterior condition

Where shaded exterior surfaces dry slowly, review ventilation, plant clearance, drainage, and coating conditions together. For Sammamish work, the material specification should follow the measured exposure at the house.

Official local resources

Check the requirements for your property.

Start with City of Sammamish. Requirements depend on the parcel and scope; confirm the current pathway before relying on a permit assumption.
